tinyfish.note: TinyFish hosted MCP server. This manifest is OAuth-only: on first connection you are prompted to sign in to your TinyFish account in the browser. It carries no API key because Grok drops X-API-Key once a server advertises OAuth metadata; for key auth, register the server with the CLI instead — `npx -y @tiny-fish/cli@latest connect grok --api-key <key>` writes an `Authorization: Bearer ${TINYFISH_API_KEY}` header, exports the key to your shell profile, and skips the browser sign-in — restart Grok afterwards. Tools this plugin uses: search and fetch_content (both free), run_web_automation and run_web_automation_async for goal-driven multi-step automation (including logged-in sites via use_profile and use_vault), get_run and cancel_run for a single run, batch_status and batch_cancel to poll or cancel several runs at once by ID, and create_browser_session and close_browser_session for CDP control from Playwright or Puppeteer.
